name: CodeNeRF
aliases: CodeNeRF — Disentangled Neural Radiance Fields for Object Categories
Disentangled Neural Radiance Fields for Object Categories
definition: CodeNeRF is an implicit 3D neural representation that learns the variation of object shapes and textures across a category. It disentangles shape and texture by learning separate embeddings, allowing it to synthesize novel views of unseen objects from a single unposed input image by jointly optimizing camera viewpoint and latent codes.
summary: CodeNeRF is a neural radiance field that disentangles shape and texture via separate latent embeddings, enabling novel view synthesis and explicit editing of unseen objects from a single unposed image.
